# Paychex Schedules First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Conference Call on September 23, 2026


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_111ceb204cdd2300c8836fbfcdce0f6e/paychex/news/2026-09-09_Paychex_Schedules_First_Quarter_Fiscal_2027_847.pdf) September 09, 2026 9:15am EDT


ROCHESTER, N.Y., Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Paychex, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cN4liHM-rfy4US91D1suO6SDLYRnLn8MU7-6_cYZJ_1jXefYdNkOL2LjKzzFwwRhOuRZnahJMrzwYJk7-wwYRw==) (Nasdaq: PAYX), a leading provider of expert-enabled HR, payroll, and benefits, today announced that it is scheduled to release financial results for its fiscal 2027 first quarter ended August 31, 2026 on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, before the financial markets open.


The company will host a conference call at 9:30 a.m. ET on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 to discuss these results. Participating in this call will be[John Gibson](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=c6J3_OJV8z94buKr6gRIerxImxz7o-gpwAdegTpuah2KEUHV5h3oqkfM9xYOCAdU5hCg3bcHtZN82eANcdynow54hMehpQ2uj-XxeXNWMsIeNWunD9RdJRk_a2huAiQsCgFqR04leBDmvDwCPx-hPA==) , President and Chief Executive Officer, and[Bob Schrader](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PKynadGpPw4uOwfcbxG-QtowMZVmQNL08_iUN39arff3WP9iUwvU4lR96VQyNDR9M3S3z9rt8JzFcU3MVIqMmub5mlobqg3EIE7G8cqQWjtwf7O-QWQEmX8ASe-bXazIsoR2xQtoJYCG0yHgRlhtmg==) , Chief Financial Officer.


The conference call will be webcast live and available for replay on the[Paychex Investor Relations portal.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cN4liHM-rfy4US91D1suO-itvGMvPEt2RIboN8TzxAINzDuMj4sboDaTOCJx6BW0P6baHKlf4SnGwXgtXrxFkBlO0QrUEFLiBalk-loCMUbPp90Ee4-zzj3X79Qc1uWC)


**About Paychex**
Paychex, Inc. (Nasdaq: PAYX) provides a comprehensive suite of expert-enabled technology and advisory solutions that help businesses manage HR, payroll, and benefits. Serving approximately 840,000 customers and paying 1 in 11 U.S. private sector workers, Paychex combines scale, trusted expertise, and innovation to help businesses succeed. Built on more than 50 years of workforce experience and one of the industry’s largest proprietary HR datasets, Paychex’s WISE agentic AI engine embeds intelligence directly into workflows to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and deliver better outcomes. Learn more at[paychex.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=z7t-AxP-BZrhAImRZSa0PlDvLc6hSBE8KQmkniBLXkb1DOCRsq1B5t6lTh9rXUSJLq5KUWYRTSaWJNPoD5SKyw==) .


Paychex, Inc.’s news releases, current financial information, SEC filings, and investor presentations are accessible on the[Paychex Investor Relations portal.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cN4liHM-rfy4US91D1suO-itvGMvPEt2RIboN8TzxALeACn2VL-pXloOOeIsa-bakzDErEpoN1tJJLD9E4eoHK3PvaSrCCsFyGkzleZzU3zolmgxcJ6yyNRTvrWiUn_Y)
